title: How Did LeBron Earn $1 Billion While Playing?
description:
How did LeBron James make a billion dollars while still playing?

Sources:
- Wikipedia: LeBron James: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/LeBron_James

From the cited page: seven-year Nike deal signed in May 2003, coming out of high school, for approximately $90 million; more than $30 million from the sale of his Beats stake in 2014; minority stake in Liverpool FC through a 2011 Fenway Sports Group deal; first player in NBA history to accumulate $1 billion in earnings as an active player (2021). Not financial advice.

scenes.narration: How did LeBron James make a billion dollars while still playing?
May 2003. Just out of high school. A shoe deal worth about 90 million.
Then his stake in Beats paid over 30 million.
Not just hoops. He got a stake in Liverpool soccer club.
The result? The first NBA player to earn a billion while still playing.
